methodology.kind: Single-run controlled lab comparison, not field Web Vitals

methodology.observations: Photo readiness is the real image load event, measured from navigation. Transfer includes completed requests up to 9 main photos ready; the redesigned page also loads 4 discovery photos. LCP omitted: sampled before its image paint callback. Frame sample includes startup and landing. Preliminary malformed-fixture runs are superseded.
